overall_goal: Mash boiled potatoes, mix with chicken and cheese, and form coated balls

goals.description: Transfer boiled potatoes from the saucepan to a bowl
goals.rationale: The person moves the saucepan of boiled potatoes from the hob and scoops the potatoes into a Pyrex bowl.

goals.description: Mash the boiled potatoes in the bowl
goals.rationale: The person uses a potato masher to crush the boiled potatoes in the Pyrex bowl.

goals.description: Clean and dry the saucepan for reuse
goals.rationale: The person empties the remaining potato bits from the saucepan, rinses it in the sink, and places it back on the hob to dry.

goals.description: Transfer mashed potatoes to the saucepan and mix ingredients
goals.rationale: The person moves the mashed potatoes into the dried saucepan and begins stirring the ingredients together.

goals.description: Retrieve and wash a serving spoon
goals.rationale: The person gets a serving spoon from a drawer and washes it at the sink.

goals.description: Clear and wipe the kitchen counter
goals.rationale: The person places used bowls and utensils in the sink and wipes the counter surface with a rag.

goals.description: Add cheese to the saucepan and mix the filling
goals.rationale: The person empties a bag of cheese into the saucepan and mixes it with the chicken and potatoes.

goals.description: Prepare a sheet of foil on the counter
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a roll of foil from a drawer, tears off a sheet, and returns the roll.
The person washes their hands with soap at the sink and dries them with a towel to prepare for molding the mixture.

goals.description: Mold the mixture into a ball and coat with flour
goals.rationale: The person scoops the potato and chicken mixture, molds it into a ball, and sprinkles flour over it.

goals.description: Coat the ball in egg and breadcrumbs
goals.rationale: The person dips the floured ball into an egg wash, rolls it in breadcrumbs, and places it on the foil.
